resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR gives 598 ft (182 m), which matches our record; Tennessee Landforms gives 588 ft. We keep the NHLR figure and note the gap.

NHLR names the Division of Forestry as administrator and its Cooperators field lists the site as privately owned. We keep the Division as administrator and record access as private, based on that field and the 2023 visitor's belief.

sources.title: Tennessee Division of Forestry Fire Lookout Towers multiple property nomination

notes_for_editor: Two NHLR records are titled Liberty Lookout Tower. This one is US 1754, TN 58 in Madison County. US 820, TN 8 in Bradley County (built 2003 from two former TDF towers, Sparta and Sale Creek) is a different site at http://nhlr.org/lookouts/us/tn/liberty-lookout-tower/ and should not be merged with it. No build date, builder, staffing or fire history found in the sources read. The brief listed access as unknown; the Register's Cooperators field and the 2023 visitor's belief point to private, but neither the owner nor the Division has confirmed it. The do-not-climb and ask-the-landowner advice in the story is the editor's recommendation, not a Register statement. Elevation: Register 598 ft, Landforms 588 ft; Register used.
